avis.titre: Finally, a Hyaluronic Acid Serum That Actually Works on Mature, Dry SkinFinally, a Hyaluronic Acid Serum That Actually W
avis.texte: I’m 52 with post-menopausal mature dry skin, and hydration is non-negotiable for me. If a serum doesn’t genuinely hydrate, my skin shows it immediately—tightness, dullness, fine lines looking deeper, and makeup clinging where it shouldn’t. I’ve tried a lot of hyaluronic acid serums over the years, and many either sit on the skin or feel great for five minutes and then vanish. Torriden Dive-In is different. I can feel the difference by mid-day, which is when most hyaluronic acid serums fail me. The texture is lightweight but not watery or flimsy. It has a smooth, fluid consistency that spreads easily and evenly without dragging on the skin, and a little goes a long way. It absorbs quickly but doesn’t disappear on contact—my skin actually feels hydrated, not just temporarily damp. What really stands out for me is that the hydration lasts. My skin stays comfortable, plump, and supple for hours, not minutes. Fine lines look softer simply because my skin is properly hydrated, and that tight, dry feeling never comes back during the day. Despite delivering real moisture, it feels weightless and never sticky or tacky. I can layer it with other serums, moisturizer, and sunscreen with no pilling, and it works beautifully under makeup. I’ve had zero irritation with this serum—no stinging, redness, or sensitivity—which is important for mature, dryness-prone skin that can easily react. The quality feels excellent and well thought out, not like a basic hyaluronic acid formula. With consist

avis.titre: Lightweight Serum That Leaves Skin Hydrated and Glowing
avis.texte: I recently tried the Torriden DIVE IN Hyaluronic Acid Serum, and I am extremely impressed with the results. The serum feels lightweight, absorbs quickly into the skin, and provides deep hydration without feeling sticky or heavy. After using it consistently, my skin feels softer, smoother, and looks noticeably more radiant with that healthy “glass skin” glow. I also appreciate that it layers well under moisturizer and makeup without causing irritation. This serum is perfect for anyone looking to boost hydration and improve overall skin texture. The quality feels luxurious, and a little goes a long way. I would definitely recommend this product to anyone interested in Korean K-Beauty skincare and achieving hydrated, glowing skin.

avis.titre: Hydrating, Lightweight, Affordable and EffectiveHydrating, Lightweight, Affordable and Effective
avis.texte: I have been using this serum for almost 4 years, and I can confidently say it is one of the best skincare products I have ever purchased. It was originally recommended to me by a colleague, and I am so grateful I decided to try it. Since then, I have never felt the need to look for another hyaluronic acid serum. One of the things I love most is how gentle it is. It doesn’t irritate my skin, clog my pores, or leave any greasy residue behind. A little goes a long way, so one bottle lasts quite a while, making it an excellent value for the price. Considering the quality, performance, and affordable price point, this serum is truly a hidden gem. After four years of consistent use, I can honestly say it has earned a permanent place in my skincare routine. If you’re looking for a hydrating serum that actually delivers results, I highly recommend giving this one a try!

I’ve been using the Torriden DIVE IN Hyaluronic Acid Serum for a while now, and it’s an okay product, but not amazing. The serum has a lightweight, watery texture that absorbs quickly and provides decent hydration without feeling sticky or heavy. It does help with basic moisture and works well under makeup, but I didn’t notice a significant improvement in glow or long-lasting hydration as advertised. For very dry skin, the hydration may not be enough on its own and needs to be layered with a heavier moisturizer. The ingredients are gentle and didn’t irritate my skin, which is a plus. However, considering the price (even as a pack of two), the results feel fairly average. Overall, it’s a safe and mild serum, but nothing particularly standout compared to other hyaluronic acid serums on the market.

Ich habe keine Rötungen oder Schuppungen mehr. Ich benutze das Serum jeden Tag morgens und abends nach der Reinigung und dem Toner. I've been using the Torriden Hyaluronic Deep Hydration Serum twice a day, morning and night, for almost two months, and it's become a staple in my skincare routine. I've only been using it for 2 weeks, but I appreciate the hydration & it's not sticky like other HA's I've used. I have rosacea/sensitive skin & this soothes my skin when it feels especially dry & angry. Hyaluronic acid works on your face by acting as a powerful humectant, attracting & holding water molecules to the skin's surface to provide deep hydration & a plumping effect. This process helps to smooth the skin's texture, reduce the appearance of fine lines & wrinkles, & strengthen the skin's natural barrier. Hyaluronic acid (HA) acts like a magnet, drawing water from the environment & the deeper layers of the skin to the surface. Because of this, make sure to use on damp skin. I use an essence, but even water left over from washing your face will work. Use a thicker moisturizer or facial oil to lock in the moisture & keep the water from escaping. I'm able to use this in the morning or at night. I think this is suitable for all skin types, including oily. It's not sticky, greasy or heavy. Very lightweight & hydrating. This was also a lot of product that'll last me for a while. I appreciate the glass bottle being refillable & saving a bit by buying the refill.

avis.titre: MADE ME A TOTAL CONVERT -- LOW MOLECULAR SERUM IS THE WAY TO GO
avis.texte: You know that saying: "an embarrassment of riches"? That's what I've experienced lately with a number of extraordinary skincare products. Torriden's DIVE-IN Low-molecular Hyaluronic Acid Serum is one of those products. I'm new to low-molecular formulas for deeper absorption and faster hydration, but an absolute convert. I didn't know how different it could feel, until I tried it. The key to this magic in a bottle? Per the description: Low molecular hyaluronic acid and 5D complex hyaluronic acid moisturize the skin instantly. D-Panthenol, Allantoin and Madecassoside are powerful calming ingredients that help soothing irritated skin. The formula means business and lists 17 ingredients it doesn't contain that are bad for skin. What's in the formula is first-rate, and at an extremely affordable price. The serum is thickish, slightly blue-tinged like lagoon water in the tropics, totally fragrance-free, and goes on slick like a typical serum. I absorbs quickly and skin feels hydrated and moist, without a sticky feel, and soothes. This is not a product worn all by itself. Hyaluronic acid products increase moisture volume in the skin, so this is excellent for any skin, particular dry skin as the step that underlies further steps if desired. There are disclaimers to stop using in case of irritation or allergic reaction. As someone with highly sensitive skin, I've experienced no negative effects whatsoever. The serum simply looked, felt, and worked great. All that for only $24. It's a

avis.titre: Absorbs quickly. A little goes a long way
avis.texte: This Dive-in serum is lightweight and absorbs very quickly. It's about as thick as other serums, yet I noticed I needed less product. One small drop covered more than half my face. My skin felt hydrated and not weighed down with this. Great for a bit of moisturization in warm weather, and it feels light underneath a moisturizer too. The serum is light blue and clear. It has no discernable fragrance. I like the dropper - there's a bit of a stopper around the opening, so that it forms a leakproof seal. Ingredients: Water, Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, Dipropylene Glycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid(500ppm), Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate Cross polymer, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Allantoin, Trehalose, Betaine, Propanediol, Portulaca Oleracea Extract, Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Leaf Extract, Madecassoside, Madecassic Acid, Ceramide NP, Beta-Glucan, Malachite Extract, Cholesterol, Pentylene Glycol, Glyceryl Acrylate/Acrylic Acid Co polymer, PVM/MA Copolymer, Polyglyceryl-10 Laurate, Xanthan Gum, Tromethamine, Carbomer, Ethylhexyl glycerin, Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract, Paeonia Suffruticosa Root Extract

avis.titre: Natural Serum, Good for Sensitive Skin

I use the serum after my skin cleaning routine. The serum has a watery consistent but slightly thicker. It's not sticky at all. I use about 2 drops and pat is well into my skin. I have tried numerous serums before where it either becomes too dry or too sticky after application, but this serum was neither of that. My skin absorbs it immediately and keeps it moist and hydrated. No wonder it was voted #1 beauty product two years in a row.
